{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Eagle Ford Midstream Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001603145/000160314515000094/nepform8k091015.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Brasada Processing Plant, LaSalle County, Texas to Agua Dulce Hub, Nueces County, Texas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=9618|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=10016|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
